validation.note: Only forecasts frozen before kickoff are graded. Alternate lines for the same player are correlated evidence; event/player/date counts are shown. Sparse or missing participation stays pending. No betting profit or ROI is inferred.

player_stat_outlook.note: Conditional statistical outlooks, not sportsbook lines, calibrated hit probabilities or qualified bets. Frozen history starts with the first saved pregame forecast.
